FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 471
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Arnold Mooney
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/24/2026
House Bill 471 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment, which if ratified, would
provide for the election of a Lieutenant Governor at the next general election, if a vacancy
occurs in that office more than sixty days prior to the general election.
Additionally, this bill would increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
